answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. This works because the originality bar tightens as more low-quality answers appear, raising the per-alias cost of a coordinated fake campaign. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a river as the anchor of the cost. A ocean stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a horizon...
